name: boomi-dashboard
description: Boomi Companion at a glance while you build, across all its plugins: what Claude did, what needs attention, watched components and the session's cost

paneTheme.title: Pane colors
paneTheme.description: The pane's colors, which the pane's theme buttons and /bc-dashboard theme also set: day (Valence Day, light, with its own background), night (Valence Night, dark) or terminal (your terminal's theme)

paneRows.title: Pane height (rows)
paneRows.description: How many rows the dashboard pane asks for when it opens above the prompt; a size you drag it to wins. 0 leaves it to Claude Code (a third of the screen)

paneColumns.title: Pane width (columns)
paneColumns.description: How many columns the dashboard pane asks for when it's docked beside a fullscreen transcript; a width you drag it to wins. 0 leaves it to Claude Code

flamingo.title: Flamingo
flamingo.description: Show the 8-bit flamingo in the pane: standing on one leg while Claude is idle, walking while it works

recentHours.title: Window (hours)
recentHours.description: How far back earlier sessions' steps and Companion's activity log count: older ones are not brought back or flagged

envFile.title: Companion .env file
envFile.description: Path of Boomi Companion's .env, relative to the session's working directory; the dashboard reads the Platform API credentials from it to check watched components

componentsDir.title: Components folder
componentsDir.description: Where Boomi Companion keeps component XML; edits to files under it show up as edited components

activityLog.title: Read Companion's activity log
activityLog.description: Also read .activity-log/activity.jsonl, which Companion writes when BOOMI_COMPANION_LOG_ACTIVITY=1 is in its .env, for script runs Claude's tool calls didn't show

pollSeconds.title: Platform poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check the watched components in Boomi; 0 turns polling off

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Pop up a toast when a step fails, a deploy or test finishes, or a watched component changes

banner.title: Banner above the prompt
banner.description: Show the latest Companion step and what needs attention above the prompt; at the start of a session, the last session's recap and tips

budgetUsd.title: Spend budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: The session's spend budget: the status line and pane warn at 80% and when it's spent; 0 turns it off

companionShare.title: Companion's share of your usage limit (%)
companionShare.description: How much of your weekly Claude usage limit Boomi Companion work may use, as a percent, over the period below: per week as it is, per day a seventh of it, per month the month's days in sevenths. The dashboard counts how far the limit moves in Companion sessions and warns at 80% and when it's used; 0 turns it off

companionSharePeriod.title: Companion share period
companionSharePeriod.description: What the share runs over: day (today), week (the last 7 days) or month (this calendar month)

companionMonthlyUsd.title: Companion's monthly amount (USD)
companionMonthlyUsd.description: A monthly amount for Boomi Companion sessions, counted as Claude Code's own cost figures (on a seat, what the same use would cost on the API); warns at 80% and when it's reached; 0 turns it off

budgetEnforce.title: When a budget is spent
budgetEnforce.description: What happens once any budget you set (budgetUsd, companionShare, companionMonthlyUsd) reaches 100% plus budgetGrace: warn (only warn, as before), confirm (ask you before each Companion change: create, push, deploy, undeploy, test, and the other plugins' changes) or block (refuse those changes). Reads are never stopped

budgetGrace.title: Budget grace (%)
budgetGrace.description: How far past a budget, in percent, before confirm or block starts: 10 means at 110%. 0 starts at 100%. A change already running always finishes

suggestions.title: Suggest the next step
suggestions.description: When Claude finishes a turn with a component saved but not deployed, or deployed but not tested, suggest that step in the prompt box (Tab takes it)

historyDays.title: Past sessions window (days)
historyDays.description: How far back Past Companion sessions reads Claude Code's transcripts on this machine

updateCheck.title: Check for updates
updateCheck.description: Once per interval, at the start of a session, fetch the dashboard's GitHub checkout and say when a newer version is there (run /bc-dashboard upgrade to install it). It never installs, and says nothing when offline

updateCheckHours.title: Update check interval (hours)
updateCheckHours.description: How long between update checks; 0 turns them off

reportStyle.title: HTML report style
reportStyle.description: How /bc-dashboard report html looks: exosphere (Boomi's design system, for anything Boomi people read) or expressive (Valence, Miami Deco: a display face for the title and a Flamingo accent on the sessions). --style on the command picks one for that report

reportOpen.title: Open the HTML report
reportOpen.description: Open /bc-dashboard report html's page in your browser once it's saved (open on macOS, wslview or Explorer under WSL, xdg-open on a Linux desktop). Where there's no browser to open, it only says where the file is
